sources.title: ArkAiLab-Adl/awgs-vision-v0.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AWGS Vision v0.1 is an experimental multimodal vision model designed for image safety and content classification. It is fine-tuned from Google's Gemma 4 E2B and trained to analyze images and return structured safety-related predictions.
